# Lodge

> A self-hosted personal console for servers, services, and secrets. One HTML file, zero servers, end-to-end encrypted.

## About

Lodge is a two-file personal dashboard: `dashboard.html` (the app) and `config.json` (your data, kept by you). It centralizes server inventory, service subscriptions, and an AES-GCM 256 encrypted vault — all in your browser, no server, no telemetry.

Features:
- Server inventory with aliases, tags, and one-click SSH
- Service catalog grouped by host with millisecond search
- Encrypted vault (AES-GCM 256, PBKDF2-SHA256 600k iterations)
- Offline-capable once loaded
- Static `dashboard.html` — works from iCloud Drive, NAS, VPS, GitHub Pages

## Pages

- [About / landing](https://lodge.weichao.studio/about.html): product description, features, security details, quick start, FAQ
- [Dashboard](https://lodge.weichao.studio/dashboard.html): single-user app (you pick your local `config.json`)
